Name: Deny Contractors
Purpose: Contractors are refused; every internal user passes

Name: Finance Only
Purpose: Only the finance department reaches payroll; the group name carries the seed prefix

Name: Business Hours
Purpose: A disabled binding, so a report has to distinguish bound from enforced

Name: Strong Password
Settings: length_min=12;amount_uppercase=1;amount_lowercase=1;amount_digits=1;amount_symbols=1;check_static_rules=TRUE;check_zxcvbn=TRUE;zxcvbn_score_threshold=2;error_message=Twelve characters with upper, lower, a digit and a symbol
Purpose: A password policy bound to nothing; a control that exists and governs nothing is what an audit has to surface

Name: Reputation Guard
Purpose: Refuses a client address or username that has failed five sign-ins; the reputation store is what it reads

Name: Allowed Countries
Purpose: A country allowlist on the intranet, which is the control a travelling user trips over

Name: Login Failures
Purpose: Matches failed sign-ins and is bound to the alert notification rule, which is what makes that rule fire
